questions.stem: What is the function of the Casparian strip in the endodermis of a root?

options.text: It provides structural support to prevent the root from collapsing
It stores minerals before they enter the xylem
It forces water to pass through cell membranes, allowing the plant to control what enters the xylem
It absorbs water from the soil and channels it to root hair cells

questions.explanation: The Casparian strip is a waterproof band of suberin in the endodermis cell walls. It blocks the apoplast pathway, forcing water to pass through the cell membrane (symplast pathway). This allows the plant to selectively control which substances enter the xylem.
